summary.zh-TW: 標籤一開始躺在輸入框裡，點進去或有內容時縮小浮到上方，底線從左邊畫出來。Email 格式不對時，欄位會輕輕搖一下並顯示錯誤。
summary.en: The label starts inside the field and floats up, shrinking, when you focus or type; an underline draws in from the left. An invalid email gives the field a small shake and shows an error.

text.zh-TW: 標籤浮起的條件只有兩個：正在輸入，或已經有內容。離開欄位但有填字時，標籤要留在上方，不然會蓋住文字。
text.en: The label floats for only two reasons: the field is focused, or it has a value. If you leave a filled field the label must stay up, or it would cover the text.

text.zh-TW: 只用位移和縮放（transform），不改 top 或 font-size，動畫才順。transformOrigin 設在左邊，縮小時才會貼齊輸入框的左緣。
text.en: Only translate and scale (transforms), never top or font-size, so it stays smooth. transformOrigin sits on the left so the shrunken label stays aligned to the field’s left edge.

text.zh-TW: 底線進場從左邊畫出來，離場往右收掉，方向一致看起來比較順。
text.en: The underline draws in from the left and exits to the right, so the motion reads in one direction.

text.zh-TW: 除了 focus／blur，也聽 input 事件：瀏覽器自動填入帳號密碼時不會觸發 focus，沒聽 input 標籤就會和文字疊在一起。
text.en: Besides focus/blur it listens to input: browser autofill doesn’t fire focus, and without input the label would overlap the filled text.

text.zh-TW: 錯誤時左右搖晃，幅度越來越小。搖晃要短（0.4 秒）而且小（6px 以內），太大會像在責備使用者。
text.en: A shake that gets smaller each time. Keep it short (0.4s) and small (within 6px) — bigger feels like scolding the user.
